Metadata.title: Tecktal Tutor: your AI-powered study companion
Metadata.description: Tecktal Tutor is an AI platform that helps students truly understand their coursework: smart solver, quizzes, deep research, guided learning and a voice tutor.

Hero.titleStart: An AI tutor that turns your coursework into
Hero.lead: Tecktal Tutor is your AI study companion: upload your courses, ask questions, practice with quizzes, and make progress with a voice tutor that's always available.

Manifesto.body: Tecktal Tutor is built to close the gap between raw AI and real pedagogy. Instead of just handing over the answer, it guides every student through the reasoning — explanations, practice, research and progress tracking — so understanding becomes the norm, not the exception.

Tutor.sectionTitle: Tecktal Tutor: one AI study companion, every tool you need.
Tutor.sectionSubtitle: Seven AI-powered tools that turn your coursework into real understanding.

chat.name: AI Tutor Chat
chat.description: Ask a question about any subject and get a clear, structured explanation — like having an excellent private tutor available around the clock.

highlights.1: Hands-free mode: just speak, the AI listens

solver.name: Smart Solver
solver.description: Give it a math, physics or chemistry problem: the Solver breaks down every step of the solution, formulas included, all the way to the verified result.

visualize.name: Visualizer
visualize.description: Turn a function, dataset, or concept into an interactive chart or diagram on the spot, with the underlying code ready to copy or tweak.

highlights.0: Charts, diagrams and equations rendered instantly
highlights.1: Full source code available to copy or tweak

research.name: Deep Research
research.description: Launch a deep research session on any topic: Tecktal Tutor searches your documents and the web, then writes a structured, sourced report ready to export.

highlights.0: Quick, medium or deep research plans

questions.name: Question Generator
questions.description: Automatically generate multiple-choice quizzes from your own course material to practice, with instant grading and score tracking.

learning.name: Guided Learning
learning.description: From your own notes, Tecktal Tutor builds a step-by-step lesson path, with explanations, questions and progress tracking.

knowledge.name: Knowledge Bases
knowledge.description: Upload your courses, notes and textbooks into dedicated knowledge bases: Tecktal Tutor uses them as the source for every answer.

highlights.0: One base per subject or project
highlights.1: Document processing status at a glance
